text:
devon: Hey folks — can someone take a look at PR #6123? CI is failing on e2e test `integration/login-redirect`. I'm 99% sure it's flaky and unrelated to my change but we can't merge.
ci-bot: GitHub Actions • PR #6123 — checks failed
ci-bot: ❌ integration-tests (matrix) — failure at job 'e2e-ubuntu-20.04'
mike: link? (or paste job url)
devon: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6123/checks — failing log snippet:
```
Error: Timeout waiting for redirect
at Object.redirect (tests/e2e/login.test.ts:72:15)
Received 200 OK instead of 302
```
sara: put me on this — oncall. I'll try a rebuild. rerunning now :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: Re-run requested by sara — re-run started
alex: saw this earlier, sometimes Chrome headless times out on our infra. Try setting `CI_TEST_TIMEOUT=45000` for that job or rerun with `--retry 2`.
jin: If it's genuinely flaky we should mark the test with `test.skip` or add a flaky tag and an auto-retry in the CI config. Short-term let's rerun, long-term I'll send a tiny follow-up PR to stabilize.
mike: If you add an env var tweak, keep it scoped to the e2e job only. Don't change global timeouts.
ci-bot: Re-run finished — ✅ integration-tests (matrix)
devon: awesome, green now. thanks sara :trophy:
mike: I can review the PR proper now. devon — can you address my earlier nits about the logging message? one-line change.
devon: pushed fix for log wording, force-pushed to the branch.
alex: quick look — lgtm. just squash the debug commit.
sara: approved and merged by sara — :shipit:
devon: thanks all. filing a follow-up issue to add flaky annotations and retry for login-redirect. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/2348
mike: thanks. noted for postmortem of flakes this week.
